structural_checks: Each band contains exactly 16 big-endian words.
All words satisfy the Genesis palette encoding bounds.
The three 0x00129A32 bands include exact byte matches to existing palette sources at 0x00129012, 0x00129032, and 0x00129E60.
limitations: No direct ROM consumer or published runtime pointer is known for either range.
The names deliberately avoid assigning a scene, actor, level, or palette color role.
conclusion: The two formerly unknown palette-shaped regions are now represented as provisional GRAPHICS data while their consumers remain unresolved.
